sources.summary: Two of the world's largest companies are heading to court over claims of trade secret theft. Apple alleges ex-employees took key Apple secrets and technologies to OpenAI. In responding, OpenAI claims this is based on false truths and misinformation, but even if it wasn't, it doesn't want Apple's trade secrets anyway.

sources.summary: The Nashville Metro Council just gave the go ahead for the mayor's plan to buy the land that a proposed data center will sit on through eminent domain. This will force the developer to give up the land, which sits beside the Nashville Zoo, although there is still a legal avenue that it can take to stop the action.

items.title_original: Nashville attempts to block controversial data center near zoo with eminent domain — city could force developer to sell the land for public use, rather than $700 million installation
items.summary: The Nashville Metro Council just gave the go ahead for the mayor's plan to buy the land that a proposed data center will sit on through eminent domain. This will force the developer to give up the land, which sits beside the Nashville Zoo, although there is still a legal avenue that it can take to stop the action.
items.summary_zh: 纳什维尔地铁委员会刚刚批准了市长通过征用权购买土地的计划，该土地将用于建设拟议的数据中心。这将迫使开发商放弃位于纳什维尔动物园旁边的土地，尽管仍然可以采取法律途径来阻止这一行动。

stories.title: VPN provider built a script to block Microsoft's hidden GDID tracking on Windows —  Windscribe's "deGDID" erases existing identifiers and blocks new ones from being created

sources.title: VPN provider built a script to block Microsoft's hidden GDID tracking on Windows —  Windscribe's "deGDID" erases existing identifiers and blocks new ones from being created
sources.title_en: VPN provider built a script to block Microsoft's hidden GDID tracking on Windows —  Windscribe's "deGDID" erases existing identifiers and blocks new ones from being created
sources.title_original: VPN provider built a script to block Microsoft's hidden GDID tracking on Windows —  Windscribe's "deGDID" erases existing identifiers and blocks new ones from being created
sources.summary: You can run the deGDID script on your computer to delete cached GDID keys and prevent Microsoft's servers from minting new ones in the background. The firewall you put up with this script will break certain Microsoft services and features, however, but you can always reverse it.
sources.summary_zh: 您可以在计算机上运行 deGDID 脚本来删除缓存的 GDID 密钥并防止 Microsoft 的服务器在后台生成新密钥。不过，您使用此脚本设置的防火墙会破坏某些 Microsoft 服务和功能，但您始终可以逆转它。
